NY Paid Family Leave: updates for 2026
NY Workers' Compensation Board: Disability Benefits Law

notes: Read from the official publication listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.

Method II (exact calculation), annual form: combined deduction and exemption allowance from Table A (full year: $7,400 single, $7,950 married, plus $1,000 per exemption), then the Annual Tax Rate Schedule for single or married. Head of household uses the single schedule.

The schedule's recapture zones (rates such as 7.03% and 11.44%) are ordinary marginal rates here. Annual net wages above $1,077,550 use Method III, a flat top rate on the whole amount; this calculator extends the last bracket instead, so results for pay above about $1.1 million are not exact.

Official examples are asserted in tests to within a few cents: weekly $400 single 3 exemptions = $8.01 (period tables round their breakpoints), monthly $50,000 single 3 exemptions = $3,576.63. The schedule's printed 'add' constants are whole dollars, so cumulative marginal rates differ from them by about $4 a year (36 cents on this example).

Paid Family Leave: 0.432% of gross wages with a $411.91 annual maximum (so wages above $95,349.54 add nothing). Disability (SDI): 0.5% of wages, no more than $0.60 a week ($31.20 a year); employers may but need not collect it, and the calculator assumes they do.
NYC resident tax and the Yonkers surcharge (16.75% of the state tax) are not modelled; enter an effective city rate in the local rate field.
